intro: Grieving the loss of her sister Anilia, the dryad Illiyana at Forest Song seeks vengeance against the satyrs lurking in Ashenvale. She asks Alliance champions to cull the corrupted creatures and return with their horns as proof of their downfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I can't believe that Anilia is gone... We used to play together in the forests all the time. I almost feel... Sad.
I know something that might make me feel better. Please, slay the satyrs that took Anilia from me! Bring me their horns as proof of your actions and you will forever have my gratitude.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Please, help me avenge Anilia's death.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, kind traveler. My sister's spirit is gladdened by your efforts.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
